generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
All terms and conditions are as per the tender notification and KW-2.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

Bidder can access tender documents on the website, fill them and submit the completed tender document into electronic tender on the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in / after submitting the EMD and tender processing fee in the form of e-payment. EMD will be refunded only after acceptance of successful bidder.

If the rates quoted by the contractor is lesser than the amount put to tender, the difference cost should be paid by the contractor, through DD/ FDR/NSC in the favour of Commissioner VUDA at the time of agreement.
Any damage during the progress of work, the damage cost should be beared by the contractor.
Tender application cost will not be refundable or exchangeable in case of cancellation of tender.
All materials should be in good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost.

The work should be carried out in accordance with the standard specifications specified by the department and as per the direction of the Engineer incharge of work. Maintenance period from the contractor for the above works is 2 year from the date of completion of work.
Security deposit at the rate of 5% of tender cost should be made in favour of Commissioner VUDA in the form of DD/FDR/NSC (NSC should be fledge in the name of Commissioner)
Acceptance/ Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.
Contractor should follow labour department guidelines.
Before commencing the work all the materials should be get inspected and certificate to be obtained regarding quality of materials.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period at contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by authority while granting is extension of time.
